One of our favorite weed spot in Phuket. The pricing-quality scale is the best out of all the shops we visited, and there’s a good selection of Cali strains that are comparable to the ones you’d get in California, tight indoor growth. They also have some leaves for blunts. The owner and staff are super nice and generous.

I don’t smoke much anymore BUT there’s also a bar AND desserts, and they offer wagyu steak and falafel burgers which were good, and I genuinely saw many people come in for the food only.
